newsitem.title: USA: Gilbert finalizes SAFCO unit purchase.
newsitem.headline: Gilbert finalizes SAFCO unit purchase.

text.p: Gilbert Associates Inc said on Friday it signed a definitive asset purchase agreement to buy SAFCO Corp's electronic systems division.
The companies said in a statement they expected regulatory approval in time to close the deal by September 30.
SAFCO shareholders also opted to receive $14.745 million of the $20 million in cash due them in early 1997, the companies said.

Under the original agreement, Gilbert would pay SAFCO shareholders $20 million in cash, issue $10 million in notes payable within five years at a seven percent coupon, and issue seven-year warrants exercisable to purchase 555,555 shares of Gilbert common stock at $18 per share.
Cash at closing would be paid from Gilbert's current operating cash and from an acquisition credit line.
SAFCO's electronic systems division designs, manufactures, markets and services products to evaluate the performance of wireless telephone networks.
